mentions.name: notmutt
mentions.description: A tabbed, asynchronous terminal mail client built on notmuch, featuring a unified inbox, a built-in HTML viewer with image support, an MCP server, and Lua scripting. It is designed to be very fast so users never wait on operations, tightly integrating with notmuch's full-text search and tagging engine, and supports configurable workflows such as CRM queues and optional AI summaries. Written in Go with cgo bindings to notmuch.
mentions.problem: Using neomutt with a unified inbox kept corrupting maildirs, and attempts to add async sending tasks to neomutt got no interest from that project, showing more was needed than just async mail sending.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building notmutt (notmuch + mutt). A tabbed, async terminal mail client with unified inbox, with included html viewer(with image support), mcp server, lua scripting.
mentions.author: rjzzleep
